question:
The pie chart given below shows the number of boys in 8 schools. The total number of boys in all these 8 school is 12000. Number of boys in a particular school is shown as a percent of total number of boys in all these 8 schools.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2914087d712e2172127c9b247f65cf693c3516e307c10503c815abe62c8d94c3.png] 

The average number of boys in S1 and S2 is what percent of the average number of boys in S6 and S8?
solution:
Calculation:

Now, the average number of boys in S1 and S2 is what percent of the average number of boys in S6 and S8

⇒ frac {{(31 + 7) over 2}} { {(11 + 15) over 2} } times 100\%

⇒ 146.1538% ≈ 146.15%

**∴ The average number of boys in S1 and S2 is what percent of the average number of boys in S6 and S8 is 146.15%.**
